BmsLatchChannelCfg.description: Threshold pair and dwell limits of one protection latch channel. Used by bms_prot_latch_pairs_update (channels 1 to 7) and by channel 8 of bms_protect_latch_evaluate. The two s16 thresholds are compared with one 16-bit sample field; the two u32 limits are tick counts that the channel's dwell accumulators must reach before the latch sets or clears.

fields.name: thr_a
fields.description: Threshold A. Compared with a 16-bit sample field; the arming side is 'at or below' for channels 1 and 3 and 'at or above' for channels 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 (see the object description). Unit not established; probably the sample's own scale (mV or raw ADC-like counts).

fields.name: thr_b
fields.description: Threshold B. Compared with the same sample field on the release side while the channel latch is set (at or above for channels 1 and 3, at or below for the other channels). Probably forms a hysteresis band with thr_a.

fields.name: set_limit
fields.description: Tick count the set (arming) dwell accumulator must reach before the channel latch bit is set. Probably in the same tick units as the elapsed-time argument of the caller.

fields.name: clear_limit
fields.description: Tick count the clear (release) dwell accumulator must reach before the channel latch bit is cleared.
